purpose: Define the structured transport target that replaces prompt-text compatibility for swappable native and external agent runtime engines.
operating_rule: Use prompt-text to bootstrap external framework usefulness; do not let prompt-text become the architecture.

prompt_text_compat.description: Gateway renders the canonical context envelope into bounded prompt text for runtimes that only expose text CLI/session APIs.
constraints: must preserve the canonical AgentRuntimeTurnEnvelope as source of truth
must not add engine-specific context semantics outside Gateway adapter code
must emit normalized activity, proposal, approval, output, and receipt projections
must not expose raw private framework transcripts by default

structured_json.description: Gateway sends the canonical structured turn envelope and receives structured activity/proposal/output/receipt events without prompt preamble parsing.

native_session_bridge.description: Gateway maps the canonical turn envelope into an InfRing-native runtime session/client without prompt-text compatibility.

fields.schema_version: integer monotonically versioned by Validation contract
fields.trace_id: single unified trace_id propagated from initial user request
fields.engine_id: selected runtime engine id from registry
fields.session_id: stable InfRing session id shared across engine switches
fields.user_message: bounded typed user input plus attachment refs
fields.context_pack: Gateway-owned bounded context pack; Kernel memory remains authority
fields.tool_grants: universal tool grant projection, never native-only workflow tools by default
fields.approval_requests: runtime-neutral pending approval requests and decisions
fields.assistant_output: final assistant answer projection with result refs
fields.receipts: receipt refs for durable effects and policy decisions
fields.structured_turn_ref: stable Gateway ref for the bounded structured turn payload
fields.transport_mode: current payload mode for this turn
fields.transport_target: preferred next-hop transport target for the selected engine

model_provider_context.purpose: Allows swappable framework runtimes to use the selected provider/model without coupling Shell or Kernel to a provider-specific schema.

model_provider_inheritance_policy.rule: Framework runtimes may inherit the active InfRing LLM provider/model only through Gateway-owned non-secret projections and adapter-owned credential materialization.
shell_rules: Shell may display framework-aware model rows and selected provider/model labels.
Shell must not receive, persist, or transmit raw API keys or secret values.
Shell selection is advisory until Gateway attaches a model_provider_context to the turn.
adapter_rules: Adapters translate model_provider_context into engine-specific args or environment only when the provider is allowlisted.
Adapters must prefer framework native auth when present, then explicit engine selection, then inherited InfRing provider/model.
Adapters must emit auth_required or config_required instead of guessing credentials.
